teaching.title: Peer Programming Mentor
bullets: Supported beginner practice sessions on variables, conditionals, and functions as a peer programming mentor.
Helped peers trace short programs step by step and facilitated discussion of common programming errors.

teaching.title: Programming Tutor
bullets: Guided beginning programmers through practice exercises on loops and debugging during tutoring sessions.
Asked learners to explain the steps in their solutions and discussed debugging approaches during tutoring sessions.

projects.title: Course Planner

Tested representative inputs for the course planner and recorded the expected outputs for those inputs.

projects.title: Document Lookup
